## Facets

- [Definitions](llms-full.txt#definitions): `SelectedEntity` is the selected entity’s change-event name; the Tooling API example for Account uses `AccountChangeEvent`. — 1 unit
- [Structure and components](llms-full.txt#structure-and-components): SelectedEntity is the change-event name of the selected entity; FilterExpression contains a SOQL-based expression with a supported subset of operators and field types. — 1 unit
- [How it works](llms-full.txt#how-it-works): Attributed event-name conflict: the Omni guide’s Apex introductory prose says `AgentWorkPresenceChangeEvent`, while its Apex trigger declaration and channel-member XML use `AgentWorkChangeEvent`.; Design inference, proposed capability step: call GetTopic for the candidate topic under the intended authentication context — 2 units
- [Problems, failure modes and limitations](llms-full.txt#problems-failure-modes-and-limitations): Pub/Sub error inspection exposes a gRPC status and description/details, a custom error code in exception trailers, and an RPC ID in the message and trailers.; The documented topic error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.topic.meta.permission maps to PERMISSION_DENIED: An error occurred while getting the metadata for the specified topic.; The documented topic error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.topic.not.found maps to NOT_FOUND: The topic information for the specified topic wasn’t found. — 8 units
- [Comparisons and alternatives](llms-full.txt#comparisons-and-alternatives): Attributed naming conflict: the Omni guide gives the subscription setting /data/ExternalRoutingChannel_chn, while its member XML uses ExternalRoutingChannel__chn and the CDC subscription guide specifies /data/ChannelName__chn.; Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: inspect each associated member individually for `SelectedEntity`, `FilterExpression`, `FullName`, and `Metadata`; compare the selected entities and predicates with the intended contract.; Design inference, proposed identity step: form the candidate topic by prefixing the retrieved channel FullName with /data/, retaining its namespace and __chn suffix. — 3 units
- [Facts and statements](llms-full.txt#facts-and-statements): The documented Omni example selects UserServicePresenceChangeEvent on ExternalRoutingChannel__chn and uses exactly: ChangeEventHeader.changeType = 'CREATE' OR (IsCurrentState = false).; The Omni example for PendingServiceRoutingChangeEvent uses RoutingModel = 'ExternalRouting' AND IsReadyForRouting = true.; The Omni Pub/Sub example for AgentWorkChangeEvent uses ChangeEventHeader.changeType = 'UPDATE' AND RoutingModel = 'ExternalRouting'. — 28 units
